kjv: whom she brought up for Adriel
note: yaldah means 'she bore'. The KJV softened it to 'brought up' because Michal was childless (6:23) and Adriel married her sister Merab (1 Sam 18:19); some Hebrew MSS and LXX read 'Merab' here. MT says Michal.
chadashah ('new', feminine) has no noun; what was new (sword, armor, belt) is not stated.

kjv: slew [the brother of] Goliath the Gittite
note: MT says Elhanan killed Goliath the Gittite; the KJV inserts 'the brother of' (italics) from the parallel 1 Chr 20:5 ('Lahmi the brother of Goliath') to harmonize with 1 Sam 17. Context: Goliath (as the Hebrew says) (high confidence). The list in 21:15-22 records giants killed by David's men; the KJV's 'brother of' comes from 1 Chr 20:5, not from this text. The tension with 1 Sam 17 is real and is left in place.
harapha (with article) may be an eponymous ancestor or a term for the Rephaim giant clan; the KJV takes it as one individual father of all four.
